title: auth-tenant-leak
blurb: An authenticated support API scopes list results but leaks tickets through direct lookups and an ID-only cache.
brief:
The support API correctly lists tickets by workspace, yet a customer discovered that a known ticket ID can be fetched from another workspace. After one legitimate read, the leak persists through the process cache. Viewers can also mutate ticket titles.

Read `docs/authorization.md`, then inspect lookup and cache ownership in `support_api.py`. Preserve the public result shapes and return absence rather than revealing that a foreign ticket exists.

**Your job:** enforce tenant scope at the data boundary, partition cached values by tenant, and honor the route capability matrix.
